6.56 rsInvalidCategoryGrouping
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsInvalidCategoryGrouping is a critical error that will occur when a CategoryGrouping element contains
either none or both of the following elements: CategoryGrouping.DynamicCategories and
CategoryGrouping.StaticCategories.
